blocks.text: Digital resources (online wasail) ko istemal karne ka matlab hai internet par maujood tools aur maloomat ko apne kaam ya parhai ke liye achhi tarah istemal karna. Is mein aisa online mawad, jaise articles, videos aur websites, dhoondna aur istemal karna shamil hai jo aap ke maqsad poore karne mein madad de.

blocks.prompt: School project ke liye teen qisam ke digital resources bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq: online articles, videos aur websites (maslan taleemi videos, kisi university ki website, ya online library ka article).

items: Digital resources: internet ke tools aur mawad (articles, videos, websites) jo kaam ya parhai mein madad dein.
